bio: It’s the perfect place to visit after a day at the beach or simply to enjoy a relaxing seaside meal. Located within a nature reserve at Praia do Ancão, this venue provides incomparable views and terraces perfect for enjoying sunny days. The house specialty — and naturally so — is fresh fish and seafood, cooked to perfection whether grilled, fried or chargrilled. In addition to the wide-ranging menu, there are daily specials featuring the freshest ingredients, and if you want to try one of the house specialties, you must order it in advance. Our suggestions? The simple yet unmissable grilled squid and the popular “à passos” tiger prawn accompanied by the sweet touch of the “à Passos” rice....
